SHRI MATA VAISHNO DEVI UNIVERSITY
Kakryal, Katra – 182320 (J&K)
(A State University recognised by UGC u/s 2(f) & 12(B) and ranked 79th in Engineering
Institutions; 24th in Architecture; among top 100 Business Schools and among top 150 Universities
in the NIRF 2021 ranking of MHRD, GoI.)
Walk-in-interview for the position of Research Associate (RP-134) at School of Business on 4th May 2022
at 10:30 a.m.
Title of the project: Social Enterprise Framework for Horticulture based Producer Organizations in Hill
States of North India
Sponsored by: MGNCRE, Ministry of Education, Government of India
Interested and eligible candidates may walk in for the interview before the Selection Committee for the position
of Research Associate in funded project purely on temporary & contractual basis for a period of 15 months or co-
terminus with the project, on 04/05/2022 at 10:30 a.m.
Qualification: Masters in Business Administration/ Economics/ Agri-Business or relevant field from a recognized
University/ Institute with 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. The candidates with experience and hands-on
knowledge of statistical packages shall be given preference.
Age: The applicant should be below the age of 40 years on the date of Walk-in-interview.
Remuneration : Rs. 20,000/- per month (fixed)
No. of Position: One
Interested candidates must send their detailed CV along with documentary proof at the email id:
deepak.jain@smvdu.ac.in before 2nd May 2022.
General terms and conditions:
1. Only eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear in the interview. The decision of the Selection
Committee will be final in this regard.
2. Candidates appearing in the interview should bring the originals of degree certificates (one set of
photocopy) and date of birth proof along with any other relevant information (e.g. experience certificate,
copies of publications if any, awards, recommendations letters etc.).
3. The above fellowship is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice or
compensation on termination of the research scheme and the Research Associate shall have no claim of
appointment. An undertaking to the effect must be given by the Research Associate at the time of joining,
if selected.
4. The selected individual may be assigned to perform any other duties time to time commensurate with his/
her qualifications. The project involves travelling in various states across India.
5. No TA/ DA is admissible for attending the interview.
Sd/-
Ref: SMVDU/R&D/22/ 388 Dr. Saurabh
